name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.170: An arrival cycle now updates the Download and Upload rows too.
    An arrival cycle starts in the dispatcher and never passes through the
    download or upload task, and those two were the only writers of their own
    row. So an arrival run did its work, logged it, and left the rows showing
    the last SCHEDULED run: measured 03.10.2026, the 06:40 and 09:45 arrival
    cycles worked both directions while the rows still read 05:58 and 06:08 -
    only the Seeder row moved. The rows were truthful about the wrong run, and
    a reader would conclude nothing had happened. The dispatcher now owns both
    rows for the arrival triggers and only for those - on a scheduled run the
    waiting task owns them - and ranks them with the same rule, so a row reads
    the same whichever path produced the cycle.
